profile.headline: Frontend Engineer @ Self Financial | React Expert | UX Obsessed
profile.summary:
Once upon a time, I wanted to be a rockstar.

Then I realized my singing voice wasn’t stadium worthy.
So I turned to psychology, but quickly figured out I might end up more confused than the people I was hoping to help.

Eventually, I landed in tech, and everything clicked.

The moment I realized I could solve real problems with just a keyboard and a creative mind, I was hooked.

Fast forward a few years:
1. I’ve grown from a junior developer to leading the front-end team for Walmart’s Warehouse Management System, which processes over 200,000 orders daily.
2. I’ve earned multiple Bravo awards for going above and beyond.
3. I even built an AI-powered job reporting app during a freelance project, automating a client’s workflow end-to-end.

I love solving tough problems, especially with AI-powered solutions, and I’m passionate about building intuitive, scalable front-end experiences that make people’s lives easier.

If you’re looking for someone who blends product thinking, leadership, and hands-on front-end expertise (with just a hint of rockstar energy 🎸)… let’s connect!

> DM me or reach out, always happy to chat about tech, AI, or the best debugging playlists.

Check my web portfolio: https://portfolio.abperez.com

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Frontend Lead
positions.description:
- Cut production UI defects ~80% by enforcing flow/integration tests on every PR across 12 React apps handling ~100,000 daily orders.
- Doubled order throughput by leading end-to-end development of a warehouse scalability feature.
- Led a 4-engineer squad shipping feature-flagged changes across 100+ tenants, keeping operations stable at scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated a legacy CRA app to Next.js with CI/CD, cutting release issues and doubling debugging speed.
- Raised test coverage 57% with Jest/RTL, reducing regressions and making releases faster.
- Drove i18n Spanish-MX support across 8 apps, doubled Mexico adoption, and picked up 3 Bravo Awards along the way.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Spring Boot and +21 skills

positions.title: Full stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
♦️ Developed a serverless application on Azure for refineries. This application launched into 8 refineries globally
♦️ Automated infrastructure of React.js app with Terraform
♦️ Efficiently worked as a Scrum team using Azure DevOps for versioning control, project management, and CI/CD
♦️ Hardened app by migrating current authentication to a role-based authentication
♦️ Lowered replication cost by redesigning the entire database using Azure Table Storage

positions.title: Admin Analyst Intern
positions.description:
♦️ Combined previous data visualizations into one automated and manageable web dashboard with Flask
♦️ Automated software delivery process by setting up CI/CD pipeline in OpenShift Container Platform
♦️ Worked in an Agile development cycle using Scrum methodologies

projects.title: Flex Job Reports
projects.description:
– Launched to production in 6 months by owning discovery, UX, and full-stack development (React Native + Supabase/PostgreSQL)—enabling technician & admin reporting.
– Eliminated 100% of admin retyping by adding a Generative AI summarizer (Large Language Model) that generates and emails structured reports at submit—freeing back-oﬃce staﬀ.
– Cut job-report time ~70% by delivering a dynamic form builder that lets admins create/edit per-system templates—speeding technicians on-site.

projects.title: Web Portfolio
projects.description: Designed and developed UI/UX of responsive web portfolio. Completed project using Figma, HTLM, CSS, and Javascript
